summary: Migrated yard/quayline.py to v4 (paths, fields, UTC Z timestamps, YYYY-MM-DD dates, v4->v3 status mapping with comma-separated filters, PATCH cancel instead of the deprecated /cancel, new error body, 201 on create) while keeping the public API unchanged; the unit test passes. Caveats: the guide's index page (quayline-migration-v4) returned 403, so I used its sub-pages; the statuses page (expired = v3 pending) conflicts with the changelog (v3 cancelled), and I followed the statuses page.
